purpose: Qualify an exact, independently implemented application of published Morales-Ramis/monodromy obstructions for the positive-mass planar Newtonian three-body problem near the parabolic Lagrange solution.
evidence_boundary: A passing result verifies the source identities, exactly reproduces the published symmetric mass invariant and exceptional-set arithmetic, cross-checks an independent implementation, and applies two published non-complete-integrability theorems to the declared positive-mass planar model and project mass corpus. It is a theorem replication/application, not a new derivation of the 4x4 normal variational system, its factorization, local logarithms, monodromy generators, or differential Galois group. It establishes no obstruction for the spatial system as such, the zero-angular-momentum level in isolation, non-meromorphic or non-Liouville integrability, the regularized upstairs atlas, or any WP3 candidate. Exceptional first-variational-equation polynomial invariants are not nonlinear first integrals.

published_contract.model: positive-mass planar Newtonian three-body Hamiltonian after the reductions declared by the sources
published_contract.particular_solution: parabolic Lagrange equilateral solution with fixed nonzero angular momentum
published_contract.universal_result: No two additional independent meromorphic first integrals exist near the declared solution; therefore the planar system is not completely meromorphically integrable in the Liouville-Arnold sense.
published_contract.exception_interpretation: The first normal variational equation has a polynomial invariant. This does not establish an additional nonlinear integral or complete integrability.

project_application.mass_parsing: Every hexadecimal or decimal input is converted to its exact rational value; exceptional-set membership uses equality, never tolerance.

independent_reference.reference_arithmetic: SymPy Rational in a source-disjoint module

decision_policy.PASS: All source, exact arithmetic, independent-reference, project-corpus, and boundary gates pass under the frozen implementation.
decision_policy.FAIL: Any source mismatch, arithmetic disagreement, nonpositive mass, classification error, missing case, placeholder-solver dependency, or boundary violation fails the qualification.
decision_policy.AUTHORIZED_CLAIM: Conditional on the two pinned published analyses, the declared positive-mass planar Newtonian three-body Hamiltonian is not completely integrable with meromorphic first integrals near the parabolic Lagrange solution. The exact project mass corpus satisfies the theorem's positive-mass hypothesis.
